SBI Junior Associates Clerk PET Admit Card 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : State Bank of India (SBI) has released the admit card for the Post of Junior Associates Clerk. This recruitment was released for 9,124 posts. Applications for the SBI Clerk JA Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 11 August 2026 to 27 August 2026. The examination is going to conducted on 31 August 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their SBI Clerk JA PET Admit Card 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 11 August 2026
  • Last Date : 31 August 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 31 August 2026
  • PET Exam Date : 15 September 2026
  • Pre Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 750/-
  • SC, ST, PH : 0/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
